# MarkFord.net

> A personal platform showcasing Mark Ford's essays on entrepreneurship, productivity, and life philosophy, alongside his creative ventures in art, nonprofit work, and published writing.

MarkFord.net serves as a digital portfolio and journal for Mark Morgan Ford, the entrepreneur and founder of Early to Rise, featuring personal reflections on business, productivity, and existential themes. The site integrates his professional interests—including Ford Fine Art gallery and the FunLimón nonprofit in Nicaragua—with ongoing personal essays and book reviews.

## Key Topics

- Entrepreneurship
- Productivity & Time Management
- Personal Essays
- Work-Life Balance
- Wealth Building
- Life Planning & Mortality
- AI & Future Technology
- Ford Fine Art
- FunLimón Foundation
- Mark Ford
- Business Opportunities
- Aging & Health
- Personal Reflection
- Nicaragua
- Delray Beach

## About & Core

- [MarkFord.net](https://www.markford.net): Homepage featuring personal essays on productivity, entrepreneurship, and life reflections
- [About Mark Ford](https://www.markford.net/about-me): Biography of Mark Morgan Ford, entrepreneur and founder of Early to Rise
- [What is MarkFord.net?](https://www.markford.net/about): Overview of MarkFord.net as a writing portfolio and creative work collection

## Creative & Philanthropic Ventures

- [Ford Fine Art](https://www.markford.net/ford-fine-art): Ford Fine Art gallery specializing in Latin American modern and contemporary art
- [FunLimón](https://www.markford.net/funlimon): FunLimón nonprofit foundation providing technical education in Nicaragua
- [My Books](https://www.markford.net/books): Catalog of Mark Ford's published books on poetry, art history, and modernism

## Personal Essays & Reflections

- [Being Busy and Falling Behind](https://www.markford.net/2026/03/13/being-busy-and-falling-behind): Personal reflection on productivity and time management with Thoreau quote
- [Four Quick and Yet Surprisingly Profound Book Reviews](https://www.markford.net/2026/03/13/four-quick-and-yet-surprisingly-profound-book-reviews): Book reviews of fiction and historical fiction with literary analysis
- [March 19, 2026 (Mortality & Existential Reflection)](https://www.markford.net/2026/03/09): Journal entry reflecting on mortality, aging, friendship, and existential themes
- [Worth Reading: Education in America](https://www.markford.net/2026/03/13/worth-reading-education-in-america): Curated links on American education policy and student performance issues

## Business & Entrepreneurship

- [March 19, 2026 (Work-Life Balance & Opportunities)](https://www.markford.net/2026/03/13): Journal entry on work-life balance, productivity, and entrepreneurial opportunities
- [February 2026 Archive](https://www.markford.net/2026/02): Monthly archive featuring business launches, entrepreneurship, and wealth-building
